site.dial.axis.awareness.def: Self-awareness: a seat is known through the clarity of what it renders, and one that acts on its own is opaque to its owner.
site.dial.axis.awareness.label: Awareness
site.dial.axis.control.def: How reliably the seat does what its owner intends, minus its contrary streak.
site.dial.axis.control.label: Control
site.dial.axis.endurance.def: How much of the time this seat can stay awake and carrying load.
site.dial.axis.endurance.label: Endurance
site.dial.axis.precision.def: How coherent the output is — the glyph's particle fidelity, degraded by static.
site.dial.axis.precision.label: Precision
site.dial.axis.speed.def: How quickly the seat answers when called — its response latency, folded to 0–1.
site.dial.axis.speed.label: Speed
site.dial.derivationNote: Derived from the same parameters the glyph renders from; the maturity slider feeds both.
